_comment: What each publisher permits without written permission.
Every entry records where the rule came from, because these terms change and an
unsourced number in a file like this is worse than no number at all. Checked
2026-08-03. If you are preparing something for publication, confirm against the
publisher's current page -- this is a warning system, not legal advice.
Note that the units differ. The National Council of Churches counts verses; the
Confraternity of Christian Doctrine counts words. A single limit would be wrong for

nrsvce.holder: National Council of the Churches of Christ in the United States of America
nrsvce.summary: up to 500 verses, provided the total is less than one whole book and less than 50% of the work's words

nabre.holder: Confraternity of Christian Doctrine, Washington, D.C.
nabre.contact: the Associate Director, Permissions, Confraternity of Christian Doctrine
nabre.summary: up to 5,000 words, provided the use is less than 40% of a single book of the Bible and less than 40% of the work

rsv2ce.holder: Ignatius Press (translation copyright National Council of the Churches)
rsv2ce.summary: no quota is published; Ignatius Press handles permissions for this edition directly

gntce.contact: American Bible Society rights and permissions
gntce.summary: no quota is published here; confirm with the American Bible Society

ncb.summary: no quota is published here; confirm with the publisher

novavulgata.summary: no quota is published; the Nova Vulgata is under Vatican copyright and reuse should be confirmed with Libreria Editrice Vaticana

public_domain.akjv: American King James Version. Public domain.
public_domain.webc: World English Bible, Catholic Edition. Public domain.
public_domain.nheb: New Heart English Bible. Public domain.
public_domain.bbe: Bible in Basic English. Public domain.
public_domain.bsb: Berean Standard Bible. Dedicated to the public domain on 30 April 2023.

recommended_alternative.name: Berean Standard Bible
recommended_alternative.note: dedicated to the public domain on 30 April 2023, and so carries no quota at all
